servicesPage.title: Services
servicesPage.subtitle: We build technology that solves real problems. Four disciplines, each executed with specialist depth.
servicesPage.intro: At LX3 we deliver custom software development for mid-market companies in Chile and Latin America. Our four services — internal applications, AI automation, websites, and technology consulting — are designed to solve concrete operational problems, not to sell generic licenses. Whether your company needs a custom ERP, a CRM that fits your sales process, or AI automation that actually works, we partner with you from discovery through delivery. Every project includes scope definition, functional prototypes, and iterative sprints with demos every two weeks. Our philosophy: software is not done until it is in production.

internalApps.title: Custom Internal Apps
internalApps.headline: Your operations deserve better than spreadsheets
internalApps.description: We build tailored internal platforms that centralize your data, automate workflows, and give your team a single source of truth. ERPs, dashboards, management systems -- designed around how your business actually operates.
internalApps.introExpanded: Custom software for businesses is the solution when off-the-shelf systems do not fit your operation. At LX3 we build internal applications that replace Excel, scattered forms, and manual processes: ERPs that manage contracts and shifts, CRMs tailored to your sales cycle, real-time operational dashboards, client and supplier portals, and mobile apps for field teams. A real example is OPAI, the ERP with 20+ modules we built for Gard Security, managing contracts, guards, HR, billing, and reports in a single platform.
forWho: Companies with unique processes that do not fit SAP, Odoo, or Salesforce
Teams spending hours copying data between Excel and systems
Operations needing real-time visibility (shifts, inventory, sales)
Companies wanting a client or supplier portal integrated with their ERP
process: Discovery: we understand your operation, processes, and pain. We define scope and priorities.
Design: functional prototypes and technical architecture. You see the product before we build it.
Development: 2-week sprints with functional demos. Integration with your existing systems.
Evolution: monitoring, continuous improvement, and support. The software improves with each iteration.
internalApps.techStack: We use Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Claude AI to build robust, scalable applications. The same stack we apply to OPAI and enterprise-level projects.

aiAutomation.title: AI Automation
aiAutomation.headline: Turn repetitive work into intelligent systems
aiAutomation.description: We design and deploy AI-powered workflows that automate document processing, decision-making, and data extraction. Built on your data, integrated with your systems, and designed to improve over time.
aiAutomation.introExpanded: Process automation with artificial intelligence transforms repetitive tasks into intelligent flows. At LX3 we design AI agents: automatic document processing, AI-generated quotes, predictive analytics, and chatbots that understand your business. OPAI, the ERP we built for Gard Security, uses AI to generate quotes and analyze security patterns. It is not an endless pilot: it is software in production, used every day by real teams.
forWho: Companies that process documents manually (invoices, contracts, reports)
Teams that answer the same questions over and over
Operations needing quotes or reports generated automatically
Companies wanting an AI agent connected to their data and systems
process: Discovery: we identify processes with highest impact and technical feasibility.
Design: we define flows, integrations, and business rules for the AI agent.
Development: we build on Claude AI, connect to your data and APIs.
Iteration: the system improves with real feedback and new use cases.
aiAutomation.techStack: Claude AI, Next.js, React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. We integrate LLMs with your existing flows to create agents that actually work in production.
aiAutomation.related1Label: AI Agents for Businesses: Use Cases
aiAutomation.related3Label: OPAI Case — AI-Powered ERP for Gard Security

websites.title: Websites & Digital Platforms
websites.headline: Websites that perform as hard as your team does
websites.description: High-performance, SEO-optimized websites and web applications that communicate your brand, convert visitors, and scale with your growth. Built with modern frameworks for speed and reliability.

At LX3 we design premium sites: conversion-focused design, SEO from day one, optimized speed, and responsive layout. Like gard.cl, the corporate site we built for Gard Security: it conveys the scale of a leading security company, optimized for search and lead conversion. Delivery: hosting on Vercel, domain, and documentation.
Support: continuous improvements and updatable content.

consulting.title: Tech Consulting
consulting.headline: Make the right technology decisions before you invest
consulting.description: Strategic advisory on architecture, stack selection, build-vs-buy decisions, and digital transformation roadmaps. We help mid-market companies navigate technical complexity without overspending.
consulting.introExpanded: Technology consulting for businesses avoids wrong investments. At LX3 we perform technical audits of your systems, define technology roadmap, select stack (ERP vs SaaS, build vs buy), and estimate real costs. We do not sell PowerPoints: we deliver functional prototypes and actionable recommendations. If you are unsure whether your operation needs a custom ERP, a CRM, or AI automation, we start with discovery.
forWho: Companies evaluating build vs buy software
Teams needing an audit of their current systems
Companies wanting a technology roadmap before investing
process: Audit: we review existing systems, processes, and data.
Analysis: we define options, costs, and risks of each path.
Recommendation: we deliver a document with roadmap and priorities.
Optional: prototypes to validate the solution before building.
consulting.techStack: We evaluate and recommend: Next.js, React, PostgreSQL, Claude AI, Vercel. We know the stack we use in production.

opai.title: OPAI
opai.subtitle: ERP with AI for Gard Security
opai.description: A comprehensive enterprise resource planning platform with integrated artificial intelligence, designed to manage operations, contracts, human resources, and finances for a national security company.
opai.challenge: Gard operated across disconnected spreadsheets, manual processes, and fragmented systems. Critical operational data was scattered, reporting took days, and scaling the business meant scaling the chaos.
opai.solution: We built OPAI, a custom ERP with AI capabilities that centralizes all operations into a single platform. Intelligent automation handles document processing, contract management, and operational reporting. The system integrates with existing tools and provides real-time visibility across the entire organization.
opai.results: 40% improvement in operational efficiency. 70% reduction in manual data processing. Full operational visibility in real time. The platform now supports company-wide decision-making with data-driven insights.
opai.techStack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Claude AI, Vercel. MVP delivered in 30 days.
opai.timeline: Discovery and design: 2 weeks. MVP development: 4 weeks. Continuous evolution since then.

gard.title: gard.cl
gard.subtitle: Corporate website for Gard Security
gard.description: A modern, high-performance corporate website designed to position Gard as a leading security company in Chile.
gard.challenge: Gard needed a digital presence that reflected the professionalism and scale of their operations. Their previous site was outdated, slow, and failed to communicate their value proposition effectively.
gard.solution: We designed and built a fast, SEO-optimized website with a clear information architecture, strong visual identity, and conversion-focused layout. Built with Next.js for performance and deployed on modern infrastructure.
gard.results: Significant improvement in page load speed, search engine visibility, and lead generation. The site now serves as a credible digital front door for one of Chile's growing security firms.

aboutPage.title: About
aboutPage.headline: A software studio built to ship
aboutPage.mission: We are a software development company in Chile that designs and builds intelligent applications for mid-market companies. Our mission: bring enterprise-grade software to growing businesses.
aboutPage.philosophy: LX3 is a Software Studio: we build product, we do not sell hours or PowerPoints. Every project gets a dedicated team, clear process, and commitment to delivering working software.
aboutPage.diff1: We are not a consultancy: we do not sell strategies in slides. We deliver code in production.
aboutPage.diff2: We are not a software factory: we do not sell hours. We build product with shared ownership.
aboutPage.techStack: We work with Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Claude AI, and Vercel. The same stack we use in production for OPAI and gard.cl.
aboutPage.location: Office in Santiago, Chile. Remote coverage across Latin America.
aboutPage.thesis1: LX3 exists because growing businesses deserve the same quality of software that large enterprises take for granted. We are a Chilean studio that combines engineering rigor with practical business understanding to build systems that actually make it to production.
aboutPage.thesis2: We are not a body shop and we are not a consultancy. We are builders. Every project we take on gets a dedicated team, a clear process, and a commitment to delivering working software -- not slide decks.
aboutPage.p1Desc: The deliverable is a system in production, not a document. If it is not running, it is not done.
aboutPage.p2Desc: We tell you what is hard, what is risky, and what we do not know. We would rather lose a deal than overpromise.
aboutPage.p3Desc: Everything we build belongs to you. Source code, infrastructure, documentation. No lock-in, no recurring licenses on your own software.

contactPage.title: Let's talk
contactPage.subtitle: Tell us about your project or challenge. We respond within 24 hours with an honest assessment.
contactPage.faq1Q: How much does custom software development cost?
contactPage.faq1A: It depends on scope. An MVP can start at 3-6 months of development. An initial audit or consulting has a fixed cost. We give you an approximate range in the first conversation.
contactPage.faq2Q: How long does a typical project take?
contactPage.faq2A: A functional MVP: 4-12 weeks. A full ERP: 3-6 months. The discovery and design phase takes 2-4 weeks before writing code.
contactPage.faq3A: We understand your operation, processes, and pain. We define scope, priorities, and deliver a document with recommendations and estimate. Optional: prototypes to validate before building.
contactPage.intro: Need a custom software quote? Wondering if your operations are ready for AI automation? Want to define what to build before investing? At LX3 we offer a free, no-commitment consultation. We respond within 24 hours with an honest assessment: we tell you if we can help, what approach we recommend, and an approximate investment range. We serve clients in Spanish and English. Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00–18:00 (Chile). You can reach us via the form, WhatsApp, or email.
